Accessibility

At Kiierr, we believe that everyone deserves to access the best hair growth solutions available. We recognize that our community includes people of all abilities, and we are steadfastly dedicated to making our website and its content accessible to everyone, including those with disabilities.

Every day, our team is tirelessly working on enhancing the user experience for each visitor, keeping inclusivity and accessibility at the forefront. This dedication is not just a corporate goal; it is a reflection of our core values of equality, respect, and fairness.

As part of our ongoing commitment, we’re actively working to ensure that all new and updated content on our website, created by our team, will conform to W3C WAI WCAG 2.1 Level AA. We pledge that this standard will be met by September 15, 2023.

In parallel, we are working towards ensuring that all existing web content produced by our organization will meet the same Level AA standard by September 15, 2023. This aligns with our commitment to provide an inclusive online environment for all users.

We have also established guidelines for third-party developers providing content for our site. We require them to adhere to W3C WAI WCAG 2.1 Level A, and we expect full compliance by December 15, 2023. Please be aware that this standard does not include user-generated content.

We are committed to maintaining and improving these accessibility standards. Therefore, we will conduct a review of this policy on or before September 15, 2023. The previous review of this policy took place on June 15, 2023, reinforcing our continuous efforts in this direction.

Your feedback is crucial in our journey towards accessibility. For any inquiries or suggestions regarding our accessibility efforts, please don’t hesitate to reach out to us at support@kiierr.com. Your voice matters to us, and we’re here to listen and make adjustments as necessary. At Kiierr, everyone belongs, and we’re working hard to make sure that’s more than just a statement—it’s a reality.
